configurations.//: Attach-only. preview_start cannot spawn here (it rejects every command with "cwd must be a relative path within the project root") because this checkout lives on F:\ with a space in the path. START IT YOURSELF WITH --webpack, NEVER --turbopack: measured 2026-09-01, three consecutive `--turbopack --port 3000` servers wedged solid (no answer to GET / in 25-60s) holding 3.2-5.8 GB each and still growing, while `--webpack` served HTTP 200 in 11.1s. Matches AGENTS.md 2.1: turbopack rejects the junctioned node_modules. Command: node node_modules/next/dist/bin/next dev --webpack --port 3000 -- do NOT use `pnpm exec` here: in a worktree it purges the node_modules junction before Next ever starts (measured 2026-09-03, pnpm 11.13.1 -- the deps-status check sees the lockfile has moved, aborts the purge with ERR_PNPM_ABORTED_REMOVE_MODULES_DIR_NO_TTY and exits 1, while the background task reports 'exit code 0' and port 3000 stays dead, which reads as a permissions or path problem rather than as pnpm). Same trap as AGENTS.md 5's never-`pnpm run`-in-a-worktree rule.
configurations.name: phoenix-workforce
